facts.content: Acute severe headache with subjective fever and myalgias following recent travel to Thailand; blanching pruritic rash.
facts.source_text: Acute severe headache with subjective fever and myalgias after recent travel to Thailand; blanching pruritic rash.

facts.content: Differential diagnosis includes viral illness, malaria, early dengue, potentially meningitis.
facts.source_text: DDx: viral illness (e.g., arboviral), malaria, early dengue (no bleeding/petechiae), meningitis less likely (no photophobia/neck stiffness) but not excluded.

facts.content: Medication use is providing inadequate analgesic and antipyretic control.
facts.source_text: Medication use with inadequate analgesic/antipyretic control.

facts.content: Urgent in-person assessment today at clinic hub; attend urgent care or ED if unavailable.
facts.source_text: Urgent in-person assessment today at clinic hub; if unavailable, attend urgent care/ED

facts.content: Perform full vitals, neuro exam, meningism signs, and skin exam.
facts.source_text: Exam: full vitals; neuro exam; meningism signs; skin exam

facts.content: Conduct labs including CBC, CMP, CRP, malaria rapid test, blood cultures if febrile, dengue/arboviral serology as indicated, and urinalysis.
facts.source_text: Labs: CBC, CMP, CRP, malaria rapid test/blood film; dengue/arboviral serology as indicated; blood cultures if febrile; urinalysis

facts.content: Consider CXR if respiratory symptoms develop; perform LP if meningitis suspected.
facts.source_text: Consider CXR if respiratory symptoms develop; LP only if meningitis suspected after exam

facts.content: Continue paracetamol and/or ibuprofen per standard dosing; maintain hydration.
facts.source_text: Symptomatic: continue paracetamol and/or ibuprofen per standard dosing; maintain hydration

facts.content: Safety-net advice includes immediate ED visit for severe symptoms.
facts.source_text: Safety-net: seek ED immediately if non-blanching rash, worsening headache, neck stiffness, photophobia, confusion, vomiting, bleeding/bruising, high persistent fever, or clinical deterioration

facts.content: Same-day results review and escalation as needed are planned.
facts.source_text: Follow-up: same-day results review and escalation as needed
